title: A Decomposition Method for LQ Conditional McKean-Vlasov Control Problems with Random Coefficients
abstract: arXiv:2604.12114v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: We propose a decomposition method for solving a general class of linear-quadratic (LQ) McKean-Vlasov control problems involving conditional expectations and random coefficients, where the system dynamics are driven by two independent Wiener processes. Unlike existing approaches in the literature for these problems, such as the extended stochastic maximum principle and the extended dynamic programming methods, which often involve additional technical complexities and sometimes impose restrictive conditions on control inputs, our approach decomposes the original McKean-Vlasov control problem into two decoupled stochastic optimal control problems, one of which has a constrained admissible control set. translated_title: 具有随机系数的LQ条件McKean-Vlasov控制问题的分解方法
translated_abstract: 我们提出了一种分解方法，用于求解一类涉及条件期望和随机系数的一般线性二次（LQ）McKean-Vlasov控制问题，其中系统动力学由两个独立的维纳过程驱动。与文献中处理此类问题的现有方法（如扩展随机最大值原理和扩展动态规划方法）不同，这些方法通常涉及额外的技术复杂性，有时还会对控制输入施加限制性条件，而我们的方法将原始的McKean-Vlasov控制问题分解为两个解耦的随机最优控制问题，其中一个问题具有受约束的容许控制集。这些辅助问题可以使用经典方法求解。我们建立了辅助问题的适定性和可解性与原始问题的适定性和可解性之间的等价性，并证明了最优……
tldr: 提出一种分解方法，将具有随机系数和条件期望的LQ McKean-Vlasov控制问题分解为两个可用经典方法求解的解耦随机最优控制问题，并证明了辅助问题与原问题在适定性和可解性上的等价性。
en_tdlr: A decomposition method is proposed to split LQ conditional McKean-Vlasov control problems with random coefficients into two decoupled stochastic optimal control problems solvable by classical methods, with proven equivalence in well-posedness and solvability between the auxiliary and original problems.
